Latihan 1 - MA(2)

Persiapan

set.seed(123)

theta1 <- 0.4
theta2 <- 0.6
n <- 300

Bangkitkan MA(2) Secara Manual

e <- rnorm(n)

y_ma2 <- numeric(n)

y_ma2[1] <- e[1]
y_ma2[2] <- e[2] + theta1 * e[1]

for (t in 3:n) {
  y_ma2[t] <- e[t] +
    theta1 * e[t-1] +
    theta2 * e[t-2]
}

y_ma2 <- ts(y_ma2)

head(y_ma2)
## Time Series:
## Start = 1 
## End = 6 
## Frequency = 1 
## [1] -0.5604756 -0.4543677  1.1303519  0.5558852  1.0927161  1.8090851

Bangkitkan MA(2) dengan arima.sim

set.seed(123)

ma2_sim <- arima.sim(
  model = list(ma = c(theta1, theta2)),
  n = n
)

head(ma2_sim)
## Time Series:
## Start = 1 
## End = 6 
## Frequency = 1 
## [1]  1.13035193  0.55588522  1.09271608  1.80908512  1.22451484 -0.05165576

Plot Time Series

plot(
  y_ma2,
  main = "Time Series MA(2) Manual",
  xlab = "Time",
  ylab = "Y"
)

plot(
  ma2_sim,
  main = "Time Series MA(2) arima.sim",
  xlab = "Time",
  ylab = "Y"
)

Plot ACF

acf(
  y_ma2,
  main = "ACF MA(2) Manual"
)

acf(
  ma2_sim,
  main = "ACF MA(2) arima.sim"
)

Plot PACF

pacf(
  y_ma2,
  main = "PACF MA(2) Manual"
)

pacf(
  ma2_sim,
  main = "PACF MA(2) arima.sim"
)

Plot EACF

Latihan 2 — AR(2)

Diketahui model AR(2):

\[ X_t = 0.5X_{t-1} + 0.2X_{t-2} + \varepsilon_t \]

dengan jumlah pengamatan \(n=300\).

Persiapan

# Menentukan parameter
phi1 <- 0.5
phi2 <- 0.2
n <- 300

# Seed agar hasil dapat direplikasi
set.seed(123)

Bangkitkan AR(2) Secara Manual

# Membuat error/residual
epsilon <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1)

# Menyiapkan vektor untuk data AR(2)
x_ar2 <- numeric(n)

# Nilai awal
x_ar2[1] <- epsilon[1]
x_ar2[2] <- phi1 * x_ar2[1] + epsilon[2]

# Membentuk data AR(2) secara manual
for (t in 3:n) {
  x_ar2[t] <- phi1 * x_ar2[t-1] +
              phi2 * x_ar2[t-2] +
              epsilon[t]
}

# Mengubah menjadi objek time series
y_ar2_manual <- ts(x_ar2)

# Melihat 10 data pertama
head(y_ar2_manual, 10)
## Time Series:
## Start = 1 
## End = 10 
## Frequency = 1 
##  [1] -0.5604756466 -0.5104153128  1.1914055285  0.5641280931  0.6496328874
##  [6]  2.1527070492  1.6671963081 -0.0009216707 -0.3538744256 -0.6227835171

Bangkitkan AR(2) Menggunakan arima.sim

# Membentuk AR(2) menggunakan fungsi arima.sim
set.seed(123)

y_ar2 <- arima.sim(
  model = list(ar = c(phi1, phi2)),
  n = n
)

# Melihat 10 data pertama
head(y_ar2, 10)
## Time Series:
## Start = 1 
## End = 10 
## Frequency = 1 
##  [1] -2.9518714 -1.0047928 -0.9393975 -1.8087943  0.1615383  0.1454745
##  [7] -0.1900266  0.8292073  1.2547318  1.6147884

Plot Data AR(2)

plot(
  y_ar2,
  main = "Time Series AR(2)",
  ylab = "X_t",
  xlab = "Time"
)

ACF

acf(
  y_ar2,
  main = "ACF AR(2)"
)

PACF

pacf(
  y_ar2,
  main = "PACF AR(2)"
)

EACF

Autokorelasi Teoretis AR(2)

Untuk model AR(2):

\[ X_t = \phi_1X_{t-1}+\phi_2X_{t-2}+\varepsilon_t \]

autokorelasi teoritis dapat diperoleh menggunakan fungsi ARMAacf().

# Menghitung autokorelasi teoritis AR(2)
acf_teoritis <- ARMAacf(
  ar = c(phi1, phi2),
  lag.max = 10
)

acf_teoritis
##          0          1          2          3          4          5          6 
## 1.00000000 0.62500000 0.51250000 0.38125000 0.29312500 0.22281250 0.17003125 
##          7          8          9         10 
## 0.12957812 0.09879531 0.07531328 0.05741570

Autokorelasi Sampel AR(2)

# Menghitung ACF sampel
acf_sampel <- acf(
  y_ar2,
  lag.max = 10,
  plot = FALSE
)

# Melihat jumlah nilai ACF
length(as.numeric(acf_sampel$acf))
## [1] 10
acf_sampel_table <- data.frame(
  Lag = 1:10,
  ACF_Sampel = as.numeric(acf_sampel$acf)
)

acf_sampel_table

perbandingan_acf <- data.frame(

Nilai Autokorelasi Teoretis Lag 1 dan Lag 2

Untuk AR(2), persamaan Yule-Walker memberikan:

\[ \rho_1 = \frac{\phi_1}{1-\phi_2} \]

sehingga:

\[ \rho_1 = \frac{0.5}{1-0.2}=0.625 \]

Kemudian:

\[ \rho_2 = \phi_1\rho_1+\phi_2 \]

sehingga:

\[ \rho_2=(0.5)(0.625)+0.2=0.5125 \]

# Menghitung rho teoritis secara manual

rho1 <- phi1 / (1 - phi2)
rho2 <- phi1 * rho1 + phi2

cat("Autokorelasi teoritis lag 1 =", rho1, "\n")
## Autokorelasi teoritis lag 1 = 0.625
cat("Autokorelasi teoritis lag 2 =", rho2, "\n")
## Autokorelasi teoritis lag 2 = 0.5125

Kesimpulan

cat(
  "Model yang digunakan adalah AR(2) dengan phi1 =",
  phi1,
  "dan phi2 =",
  phi2,
  "serta jumlah pengamatan sebanyak",
  n,
  ".\n"
)
## Model yang digunakan adalah AR(2) dengan phi1 = 0.5 dan phi2 = 0.2 serta jumlah pengamatan sebanyak 300 .
cat(
  "Autokorelasi teoritis lag 1 =", round(rho1, 4), "\n"
)
## Autokorelasi teoritis lag 1 = 0.625
cat(
  "Autokorelasi teoritis lag 2 =", round(rho2, 4), "\n"
)
## Autokorelasi teoritis lag 2 = 0.5125

Latihan 3 — ARMA(2,2)

Diketahui model ARMA(2,2):

\[ X_t = 0.5X_{t-1} + 0.2X_{t-2} + \varepsilon_t + 0.4\varepsilon_{t-1} + 0.6\varepsilon_{t-2} \]

dengan jumlah pengamatan \(n=300\).

Persiapan

# Menentukan parameter
phi1 <- 0.5
phi2 <- 0.2

theta1 <- 0.4
theta2 <- 0.6

n <- 300

# Seed agar hasil dapat direplikasi
set.seed(123)

Bangkitkan ARMA(2,2) Secara Manual

# Membuat error/residual
epsilon <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1)

# Menyiapkan vektor data
x_arma22 <- numeric(n)

# Nilai awal
x_arma22[1] <- epsilon[1]

x_arma22[2] <- phi1 * x_arma22[1] +
               epsilon[2] +
               theta1 * epsilon[1]

# Membentuk ARMA(2,2) secara manual
for (t in 3:n) {
  
  x_arma22[t] <- phi1 * x_arma22[t-1] +
                 phi2 * x_arma22[t-2] +
                 epsilon[t] +
                 theta1 * epsilon[t-1] +
                 theta2 * epsilon[t-2]
}

# Mengubah menjadi objek time series
y_arma22_manual <- ts(x_arma22)

# Melihat 10 data pertama
head(y_arma22_manual, 10)
## Time Series:
## Start = 1 
## End = 10 
## Frequency = 1 
##  [1] -0.5604756 -0.7346056  0.6509540  0.7344411  1.5901274  2.7510371
##  [7]  2.9180589  1.9575811  0.6460747 -0.7648863

Bangkitkan ARMA(2,2) Menggunakan arima.sim

# Membentuk ARMA(2,2) menggunakan arima.sim
set.seed(123)

y_arma22 <- arima.sim(
  model = list(
    ar = c(phi1, phi2),
    ma = c(theta1, theta2)
  ),
  n = n
)

# Melihat 10 data pertama
head(y_arma22, 10)
## Time Series:
## Start = 1 
## End = 10 
## Frequency = 1 
##  [1] -3.11187150 -2.78699743 -1.12528900 -0.87493596 -0.03472262  0.84062710
##  [7]  1.47250989  2.61429024  3.14579988  3.41808039

Plot Data ARMA(2,2)

plot(
  y_arma22,
  main = "Time Series ARMA(2,2)",
  ylab = "X_t",
  xlab = "Time"
)

ACF

acf(
  y_arma22,
  main = "ACF ARMA(2,2)"
)

PACF

pacf(
  y_arma22,
  main = "PACF ARMA(2,2)"
)

## 2 o x o o o x o o o o o  o  o  o
